verdict.rationale: Orb is a billing platform, so card-lifecycle recovery is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions network account updater, backup payment methods, or hosted update-payment pages. The only dunning-related evidence covers automatic payment retries after 1, 4, and 9 days, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, expiring or replaced cards update themselves — network account updater, backup payment methods, and hosted update-payment pages
